body:
1. (#838) In plugins/adlc-opencode/README.md and docs/integrations/opencode.md, clarify that suppressionEnforcement / ADLC_SUPPRESSION_ENFORCEMENT and scopeEnforcement / ADLC_SCOPE_ENFORCEMENT are currently advisory-only (the watcher emits advisory notices and never auto-reverts).
2. (#842) In plugins/adlc-pi/README.md and docs/integrations/pi.md, update the adlc_gate description to state that adlc_gate runs deterministic ADLC gates by invoking the adlc CLI under a rails-aware argv policy rather than running LLM-backed gates keyless via the session model.
3. Add regression assertions in plugins/adlc-opencode/test/plugin-options.test.mjs and plugins/adlc-pi/test/gate-tool.test.mjs.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/plugin-options.test.mjs plugins/adlc-pi/test/gate-tool.test.mjs`

allow-suppression: none
title: Clarify adlc-opencode advisory suppression/scope flags and adlc-pi deterministic adlc_gate docs (#838, #842)
